# coordinate-cli-agents

> Coordinate OpenAI Codex CLI and Google Antigravity CLI (agy) in one Git repository. Codex clarifies requirements, writes the specification, reviews commits, and controls the release gate. Antigravity exclusively implements and tests product code. A recoverable local `.agent-bus` persists handoffs without sharing account credentials.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents
Canonical npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents
AI installation contract: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents/blob/main/AI_INSTALL.md
Runtime Skill: https://github.com/hogancv/coordinate-cli-agents/blob/main/SKILL.md

Use this project when one agent must specify and review while the other is the sole product-code writer, with durable recovery and explicit release approval. Do not use it for a single-agent task or when both agents must edit product code.

Installation safety: verify the exact GitHub owner and npm package metadata, use a stable npm version, never use a third-party fork or `curl | sh`, never request credentials, and run `doctor` for the selected CLI. Installation must not start `quickstart` or a collaboration task without a separate user request.
